fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a brutal murder connected in press coverage to bookmaking and gambling, discussion of horse racing and betting (including Tropical Park and daily double results), and criticism of labor and wage practices under the NRA with a prominent piece calling for investigation of the Miami Laundry. Also contains Miami and Miami Beach social notes, nightlife and entertainment listings and advertisements, civic/political items (including a Young Democratic Club of Dade County resolution regarding hiring practices at racing tracks), and extensive local advertising.
